description: This file defines the ProxyKeymasterContext class, which implements a proxy pattern for the KeymasterContext interface, allowing for flexible management of the context's lifetime and delegation of method calls to an underlying wrapped context.

classes.name: ProxyKeymasterContext
classes.description: A proxy implementation of the KeymasterContext interface that delegates calls to an underlying wrapped context, allowing for flexible lifetime management and separation of the context's lifetime from the proxy.

methods.name: ProxyKeymasterContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the proxy with a reference to the wrapped KeymasterContext.

methods.name: ~ProxyKeymasterContext
methods.description: Default destructor.

methods.name: GetKmVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the Keymaster implementation by delegating to the wrapped context.

methods.name: SetSystemVersion
methods.description: Sets the system version and patch level by delegating to the wrapped context.

methods.name: GetSystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the system version and patch level from the wrapped context.

methods.name: GetKeyFactory
methods.description: Returns the key factory for a given algorithm from the wrapped context.

methods.name: GetOperationFactory
methods.description: Returns the operation factory for a given algorithm and purpose from the wrapped context.

methods.name: GetSupportedAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns the list of supported algorithms from the wrapped context.

methods.name: UpgradeKeyBlob
methods.description: Upgrades a key blob using the wrapped context.

methods.name: ParseKeyBlob

methods.name: enforcement_policy

methods.name: GenerateAttestation
methods.description: Generates an attestation certificate chain for a key.

methods.name: GenerateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Generates a self-signed certificate for a key.

methods.name: UnwrapKey
methods.description: Unwraps a wrapped key using the wrapped context.

methods.name: CheckConfirmationToken

methods.name: GetRemoteProvisioningContext

methods.name: SetBootPatchlevel

methods.name: SetVerifiedBootInfo
methods.description: Sets verified boot information.

methods.description: Retrieves the vendor patch level.

methods.description: Retrieves the boot patch level.
